name: UGC talking head — scroll-stop confession

hook.visual: Face fills frame; slight lean-in; phone selfie angle; busy-but-real background
hook.audio_or_vo: Cold open with a specific, slightly uncomfortable truth — no brand name yet
hook.text_overlay: 3–7 words mirroring the spoken hook; large, centered, high contrast
hook.pattern_interrupt: Start mid-thought / mid-emotion; never with logo sting or ‘hey guys’

beats.purpose: Name the pain with a concrete scene
beats.visual: Hold face; cut to one B-roll of the pain moment if needed
beats.vo_or_copy: Describe the failed workaround the audience already tried

beats.purpose: Introduce the mechanism, not the brand pitch
beats.visual: Demo or point-to-product / shop floor / screen; keep handheld
beats.vo_or_copy: One clear mechanism: what changed and why it works differently

beats.visual: Result shot, review screenshot crop, or before→after still
beats.vo_or_copy: One specific outcome with a number, time, or named constraint

cta.on_screen: Comment / link in bio / Learn more — one path only
cta.landing_promise: Match the hook’s promise on the landing page above the fold

audio_design.music_energy: Low or none under VO; trending bed only if it doesn’t fight speech
audio_design.vo_pace: Conversational, 140–160 wpm; pause after the hook
audio_design.captions: Burned-in, word-by-word or phrase chunks; never tiny subtitles

visual_system.camera: Front camera / selfie stick; eye-level; occasional snap zoom
visual_system.lighting: Natural window or ring light; avoid cinematic grade
visual_system.color: Native phone color; slight warmth OK
visual_system.editing_pace: Jump cuts every 1.5–3s on talking head; match cuts on demo
visual_system.text_style: Bold sans, 2 lines max, safe margins for UI chrome

why_it_works: Native feed texture beats polished brand film for cold traffic
Specific confession creates identification faster than feature lists
anti_patterns: Opening with company name or logo
Reading a script with dead eyes
metrics_signals: Strong 3-second hold relative to account baseline
Comments that restate the pain in the viewer’s words
Saves/shares on TikTok or organic short

prompt_seeds.script: Write a 28s UGC confession ad. Hook = specific painful scene. No brand until second 12. End with one soft CTA.
prompt_seeds.shot_list: 1) Face hook 2) Pain B-roll 3) Mechanism demo 4) Proof still 5) CTA face
prompt_seeds.video_gen: Handheld vertical UGC selfie of a real person mid-confession, natural light, no logos, candid energy

source_notes: Distilled from common Meta/TikTok UGC winners across consumer and local-service accounts — pattern only, no scraped creative.
